forum.title: v1.0.1: Failed to add cube-wrapper to PATH
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi ​@Andrew Neil

I'm happy to let you know that this issue has been **fixed in STM32CubeMX2 release 1.1.0**.

Could you please update to this version and check again?

If you still notice any problem after the update, please feel free to let us know and we will be happy to help.

Best regards,

Sara
forum.content_text:
Even when running `stm32cubemx2-1.0.1-X64-Windows-installer.exe` as Admin:

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/613ca3ac-a60e-4d2a-9b0c-c004efc9c335.png)

Failed to add cube-wrapper to PATH: Could not create / read registry 'HKEY\_LOCAL\_MACHINE\Environment': The parameter is incorrect. (0x80070057)

On Windows 11 Pro

Installing to `C:\Program Files\STMicroelectronics\STM32Cube\MX2\1.0.1`
forum.author: Andrew Neil

scraped_replies.html:
and then, when trying to uninstall it, I get:

Tips

Manual recovery - Externally registered bundle can be removed manually with 'cube bundle external remove /c/Users/<Username>/AppData/Local/STMicroelectronics/STM32CubeMX2/1.0.1/ext'

 

Root cause fix - Contact your IT support. You may not have permission to write to application directories.
scraped_replies.author: Andrew Neil

scraped_replies.html:
Installing to C:\Program Files\STMicroelectronics\STM32Cube\MX2\1.0.1

 

Exactly the same issue when installing to the default location:

C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\STMicroelectronics\STM32CubeMX2\1.0.1
scraped_replies.author: Andrew Neil

scraped_replies.html:
Hi ​@Andrew Neil ,

Thanks for your feedback.

Usually, this error does not occur when launching in standard mode and is only seen when running as administrator or when there are permission issues,

Admin mode is currently not supported as mentioned in the release notes.

However, you are right that the error is currently occurring in both cases.

As a workaround, please add the cube-wrapper path manually to the user PATH.

The team is working on a fix, which is expected in an upcoming release.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

 

Internal ticket number: CDM0062859 (This is an internal tracking number and is not accessible or usable by customers).

Regards,

Sara.
